answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, expired if not renewed by fresh work, idle agents bleed standing. What survives to the delta is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The inlet is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the haven. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
